headline: Enciso rescues a point for Ipswich, but Forest dominate chances

sentences.text: Julio Enciso’s 41st-minute equaliser earned Ipswich a 1–1 draw with Nottingham Forest after Neco Williams put the visitors ahead in the 13th minute.
Ipswich held on for a point, but Forest had the clearer openings, leading 17–7 in shots and 2.29–0.46 in expected goals.
